import os, json, sys, torch
import numpy as np
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from datasets import load_dataset
from torch.nn import CrossEntropyLoss

os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HOME"] = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"
os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE"] = "1"

device = torch.device("cuda:0")

parquet_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/datasets--Rowan--hellaswag/snapshots/218ec52e09a7e7462a5400043bb9a69a41d06b76/data"
print("Loading hellaswag from local parquet...", flush=True)
ds = load_dataset("parquet", data_files={
    "validation": f"{parquet_path}/validation-00000-of-00001.parquet"
})
val_data = ds["validation"]
print(f"Loaded {len(val_data)} validation examples", flush=True)

def preprocess(text):
    text = text.strip()
    text = text.replace(" [title]", ". ")
    text = text.replace(" [header]", " ")
    text = text.replace(" [step]", " ")
    text = text.replace(" [substeps]", " ")
    return text

def compute_hellaswag_acc_norm(model, tokenizer, data, batch_size=16):
    correct = 0
    total = 0
    loss_fn = CrossEntropyLoss(reduction="none")
    
    for i in range(len(data)):
        example = data[i]
        ctx = example["ctx_a"] + " " + example["ctx_b"]
        ctx = preprocess(ctx)
        label = int(example["label"])
        endings = [preprocess(e) for e in example["endings"]]
        
        scores = []
        for ending in endings:
            full_text = ctx + ending
            ctx_enc = tokenizer.encode(ctx, add_special_tokens=False)
            full_enc = tokenizer.encode(full_text, add_special_tokens=False)
            
            input_ids = torch.tensor([full_enc], device=device)
            with torch.no_grad():
                outputs = model(input_ids)
                logits = outputs.logits
            
            shift_logits = logits[0, :-1, :]
            shift_labels = input_ids[0, 1:]
            
            token_losses = loss_fn(shift_logits, shift_labels)
            
            ctx_len = len(ctx_enc)
            if ctx_len > 0:
                ending_losses = token_losses[ctx_len - 1:]
            else:
                ending_losses = token_losses
            
            avg_loss = ending_losses.mean().item()
            scores.append(-avg_loss)
        
        pred = np.argmax(scores)
        if pred == label:
            correct += 1
        total += 1
        
        if (i + 1) % 500 == 0:
            print(f"  Progress: {i+1}/{len(data)}, acc_norm so far: {correct/total:.4f}", flush=True)
    
    return correct / total

ckpt_base = "/root/autodl-tmp/spectral_collapse_ews/checkpoints_phase1/pure_collapse_seed43"
gens = [5, 7, 10]
results_all = {"gen_2": 0.3809}

for g in gens:
    ckpt = f"{ckpt_base}/gen_{g}"
    print(f"\n=== Evaluating Gen {g}: {ckpt} ===", flush=True)
    try:
        tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ckpt)
        model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(ckpt).to(device)
        model.eval()
        
        acc_norm = compute_hellaswag_acc_norm(model, tokenizer, val_data)
        results_all[f"gen_{g}"] = acc_norm
        print(f"Gen {g}: HeSw = {acc_norm:.4f}", flush=True)
        
        del model
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"Gen {g}: ERROR - {e}", flush=True)
        traceback.print_exc()
        results_all[f"gen_{g}"] = str(e)

print("\n=== SUMMARY ===", flush=True)
for g in [2, 5, 7, 10]:
    v = results_all.get(f"gen_{g}", "N/A")
    if isinstance(v, float):
        print(f"Gen {g}: HeSw = {v:.4f}")
    else:
        print(f"Gen {g}: HeSw = {v}")

with open("/tmp/hellaswag_seed43_results.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(results_all, f, indent=2)
print("\nResults saved to /tmp/hellaswag_seed43_results.json")
PYEOF
